```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { simulate, steadyState, output, breakEven } from "./solow.js"
import { scrubber } from "../js/scrubber.js"

periods = 100

viewof s = Inputs.range([0.01, 0.6], {value: 0.25, step: 0.01, label: "Investment rate, s"})
viewof alpha = Inputs.range([0.1, 0.6], {value: 0.33, step: 0.01, label: "Capital share, α"})
viewof delta = Inputs.range([0, 0.15], {value: 0.05, step: 0.005, label: "Depreciation, δ"})
viewof n = Inputs.range([0, 0.05], {value: 0.01, step: 0.001, label: "Population growth, n"})
// Each page sets `effective`: true for the effective-labour model, where technology
// grows at rate g, and false for the model with a constant level of technology, A.
viewof technology = effective
  ? Inputs.range([0, 0.05], {value: 0.02, step: 0.001, label: "Technology growth, g"})
  : Inputs.range([0.5, 3], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Technology level, A"})
viewof k0 = Inputs.range([0.1, 20], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Initial capital, k₀"})
viewof logScale = Inputs.toggle({label: "Log scale for levels"})

A = effective ? 1 : technology
g = effective ? technology : 0
perWorker = effective ? "per effective worker" : "per worker"
```
